description: Use AI to edit a landing page based on natural-language instructions. Returns an operationId — poll with get_vibe_edit_status or get_job until status is 'completed'. Optionally limit to a specific scope ('headline' | 'cta' | 'full') or a single sectionId.

instructions.description: Natural-language edit instructions, e.g. 'Make the CTA more urgent'

scope.description: Restrict edits to a specific section type

name: vibe_edit_landing_page
